record.context_brief: Autoparallel submanifolds with flat dual connection
record.original_question: More generally, how can one determine the autoparallel submanifolds of a Riemannian manifold endowed with a connection whose dual connection is flat?

evidence.quote: A more general form of the problem is to determine the ∇-autoparallel submanifolds of a Riemannian manifold with a connection ∇ whose dual connetion is flat.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M, g)$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold equipped with an affine connection $
abla$ on its tangent bundle. The dual connection $
abla^{*}$ of $
abla$ with respect to $g$ is the unique affine connection determined by the relation
$$X\, g(Y, Z) \;=\; g(
abla_{X} Y, Z) \;+\; g(Y, 
abla^{*}_{X} Z)$$
for all smooth vector fields $X, Y, Z$ on $M$. The connection $
abla^{*}$ is said to be flat if it is torsion-free and has vanishing curvature tensor (equivalently, in a neighborhood of every point of $M$ there exist local coordinates with respect to which the Christoffel symbols of $
abla^{*}$ vanish).

A smooth submanifold $N \subset M$ is called $
abla$-autoparallel if for every pair of smooth vector fields $X, Y$ tangent to $N$, the covariant derivative $
abla_{X} Y$ is again tangent to $N$ at every point of $N$.

Problem. Assume that $
abla^{*}$ is flat. Give a complete description (i.e., a structural characterization or classification) of all $
abla$-autoparallel submanifolds of $(M, g, 
abla)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal substantial work on autoparallel and doubly-autoparallel submanifolds in dually flat statistical manifolds (e.g., classification of doubly-autoparallel submanifolds of the probability simplex by Ohara and collaborators), but no complete general structural classification of $\nabla$-autoparallel submanifolds when only the dual connection $\nabla^{*}$ is assumed flat. The general problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Doubly autoparallel structure and curvature integrals
status_evidence.snippet: Doubly autoparallel submanifolds on the probability simplex can be algebraically characterized and their classification can be given.
status_evidence.claim: Classification results exist for the doubly-autoparallel case on specific dually flat manifolds, but not for the general autoparallel case under one-sided flatness.

status_evidence.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Parallel Submanifolds in Riemannian and Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of parallel/autoparallel submanifolds in (pseudo-)Riemannian settings.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys do not state a complete classification of $\nabla$-autoparallel submanifolds when $\nabla^{*}$ is flat in general.
